name: Derivative-Informed Neural Operator (DINO)
summary: Learn parameter-to-observable operators and their derivatives for gradient-sensitive inverse and control calculations.
core_idea: Jointly train a neural operator on outputs and Jacobian information, often in reduced parameter coordinates.
innovation: Prioritizes surrogate sensitivity accuracy, crucial when optimizing or sampling a posterior with learned forward maps.
limitations: Collecting training Jacobians can be expensive.
Reduced basis choices limit which derivative directions are represented.

start_here.why: Introduces DINO and explains why derivative-blind surrogates may be unsuitable for inversion.
start_here.focus: Joint output-derivative loss and reduced Jacobian representation.

start_here.why: Shows the consequence of derivative-informed operators for actual Bayesian inverse computations.
start_here.focus: Delayed acceptance and surrogate-driven geometric MCMC.
